White Casas

White Casas is a small collection of long-term rentals across South Florida, each building designed and renovated by the architect who owns it. Bright, calm spaces, an owner you deal with directly, and a place that simply feels like home.

02 — Why White Casas

Designed by an architect. Run by the owner.

Every White Casas building was designed and renovated by its owner, an architect by training. That care shows in the light, the layouts and the details, and it carries into how the buildings are run: you deal directly with the owner, backed by a trusted network of local repair pros.

Architect-designedEach building was designed and renovated with intention.
Owner-operatedNo big management company. Just a direct line to the owner.
Easy onlineApply, request service and pay rent through Buildium.
Pet friendlySmall pets welcome. See our pet policy for the details.
More about us
